name: Sable & Fork Food Service Uniform Set
description:
Sable & Fork is the dominant supplier of food service uniforms across Meridian 88's restaurant and catering industry, covering everything from Tier 2 canteens to Tier 4 corporate dining facilities. The standard set includes a double-breasted chef's coat, work trousers, and an apron, all constructed from a heat-resistant synthetic-cotton blend rated to sustained exposure at 280°C without degradation. The coat is white with black piping at the collar and cuff — a deliberate neutral that allows restaurants to add their own branding through embroidery or heat-transfer patches. The apron is a heavier canvas weave with a grease-resistant coating that repels most organic and synthetic cooking oils; it can be wiped clean during a shift and machine-washed at the end. The trouser design includes wide-leg construction to avoid heat trapping near open flame or induction surfaces.

Sable & Fork's geneware accommodation is notably thorough for food service wear, driven by the reality that kitchen workforces in M88 are highly diverse. The coat includes a rear yoke panel that opens for tail clearance, the collar sits low enough to avoid friction with common neck augments, and the hat options include a structured toque with horn-clearance inserts as well as a close-fit net cap designed for fur-bearing head configurations — both rated as equivalent hygienic coverage under Meridian 88's food safety code. The uniform set is priced at the lower end of Sable & Fork's range; higher-tier establishments typically order the structured Maison line, but the standard set is what keeps M88's food industry running.
cultural_context: The Sable & Fork white-and-black is the invisible uniform of M88 — worn by the people who feed the city, rarely seen by the people being fed. In Tier 1 and 2 communities, the uniform is associated with one of the few stable employment sectors available, and the condition of someone's Sable & Fork set is often a quiet indicator of how long they've held the job: new and stiff, or soft and stained with the specific colors of a particular kitchen.
story_hooks: A kitchen worker at a Tier 4 corporate dining facility discovers their apron's grease-resistant coating is also filtering trace compounds from the food being prepared — someone is adding something to the menu that isn't on the ingredient list.

A Sable & Fork distribution center is found to be shipping uniform sets with embedded RFID tags that aren't in the product spec — someone is using the uniforms to track food service workers across the city.
A chef's coat recovered from a crime scene carries embroidery from a restaurant that was destroyed in a fire three years ago — but the coat's fabric shows no age consistent with that timeline.
